archive_policy: Read public pinned archives only. Refuse absolute paths, traversal, non-regular entries, and bounded-size violations. Extract copies without executable modes for annotation. Archive hashes retain original source archive identity.
method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON for the sorted files list, with sorted keys and compact separators. Each row contains path, bytes, and SHA-256.
scope: Development snapshots only. Hold-out commitments are in sealed-commitments.json.
